abstract: While clinicians are devoting themselves to the study of the behaviour of ovarian cancer as well as to the search for more effective therapeutic modalities, little attention has been paid to an important route of metastasis in this group of diseases: retroperitoneal spread through the lymphatic pathway. The purpose of this report is to present a 5-year experience of a prospective study on lymph node metastasis in patients with ovarian cancer through retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy at the Peking Union Medical College Hospital. From June 1982 through May 1987, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection was performed in 105 cases of ovarian cancer. Seventy-seven (73.3%) were histologically diagnosed as cancer of epithelial origin, and 28 (26.7%) as germ-cell tumours. The overall incidence of retroperitoneal positive nodes was 54.3% (57/105). The incidence of positive pelvic nodes was 46.7% (49/105), and that of positive para-aortic nodes was 37.5% (30/80). In 69 patients who underwent systemic lymphadenectomy, 39 were found to have glandular involvement; in these 39 patients both aortic and pelvic nodes were positive in 19 cases (48.7%), aortic nodes were positive and pelvic nodes negative in 7 cases (18.0%), and pelvic nodes were positive and aortic nodes negative in 13 cases (33.3%). Preoperative lymphography was performed in 30 cases. The positive and negative correspondence rates with the pathological findings were both 83.3%. In 38 cases in which the primary cancer originated in the left ovary, 17 (44.7%) were found to have positive pelvic nodes, whereas in 25 cases with primary cancer arising in the right ovary only 2 (8%) had metastasis of the ipsilateral pelvic nodes. The lymph nodes obtained from 22 patients with positive nodes and sufficient preoperative chemotherapy were carefully examined under the microscope for the effects of the drugs. Some cellular degeneration of the lymph node metastasis was observed in only one of the 15 cases of epithelial cancer, and no response at all was noted in three cases of immature teratoma. Cellular degeneration accompanied by extensive necrosis was demonstrated in the metastatic tumours of the lymph nodes in all four cases of endodermal sinus tumour. Seventy-two patients were followed-up for at least 2 1/2 years. The rate of complete remission was 46.7% (14/30) in patients with negative nodes, but only 33.3% (14/42) in those with positive nodes. However, the difference was not statistically significant.
abstract_ja: 卵巣癌の挙動と有効な治療法の探索に臨床家が取り組んでいる一方で、この疾患群における重要な転移経路、すなわち後腹膜を介したリンパ行性進展には、ほとんど注意が払われてこなかった。本報告の目的は、北京協和医院で後腹膜リンパ節郭清を用いて卵巣癌患者のリンパ節転移を調べた、5年間の前向き研究の経験を示すことである。1982年6月から1987年5月までに、105例の卵巣癌に対して後腹膜リンパ節郭清が施行された。77例(73.3%)は上皮性由来の癌と組織学的に診断され、28例(26.7%)は胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。後腹膜リンパ節転移陽性の全体的頻度は54.3%(57/105)であった。骨盤リンパ節転移陽性の頻度は46.7%(49/105)、傍大動脈リンパ節転移陽性の頻度は37.5%(30/80)であった。系統的リンパ節郭清を施行した69例のうち、39例で腺癌の浸潤が認められた。これら39例のうち、大動脈周囲と骨盤のリンパ節がともに陽性であった例は19例(48.7%)、大動脈周囲リンパ節のみ陽性で骨盤リンパ節陰性の例は7例(18.0%)、骨盤リンパ節のみ陽性で大動脈周囲リンパ節陰性の例は13例(33.3%)であった。術前リンパ管造影を30例に施行し、病理所見との陽性・陰性の一致率はいずれも83.3%であった。原発が左卵巣に生じた38例のうち17例(44.7%)で骨盤リンパ節が陽性であったのに対し、右卵巣のみに原発があった25例では同側骨盤リンパ節転移は2例(8%)のみであった。術前化学療法が十分に施行された22例の陽性リンパ節について、薬剤効果を顕微鏡下で検討した。上皮性癌15例中1例でのみリンパ節転移の細胞変性が認められ、未熟奇形腫の3例では効果は全く認められなかった。卵黄嚢腫瘍の4例では、すべての転移腫瘍に広範な壊死を伴う細胞変性が認められた。リンパ節陰性例の完全寛解率は46.7%(14/30)であったが、陽性例では33.3%(14/42)にとどまった。ただし、その差は統計学的に有意ではなかった。72例は少なくとも2年半にわたりフォローアップされた。
